Incident history (1)

📅 2023-11-09 Missile and Artillery strikes INC-003
25 Palestinians killed from Al-Buraq School after missile and artillery strikes targeted the school. The death toll rose to 50.

The director of Gaza's Al-Shifa hospital, Mohammed Abu Selmeyah, said at least 20 Palestinians had been killed after Israel struck the Al-Buraq school in Gaza City. While the Reuters news agency reported the director as saying at least 20 Palestinians had been killed, AFP news agency put the number at about 50 people.

50 killed
